description: Machine-readable binding registry for the SRAI operator dispatch surface. Each operator maps an AIML SRAI target to a typed XCFE dispatch frame. SraiOperators.mml is the human-readable contract authority.

pipeline.description: SCORE → RANK → COLLAPSE → VERIFY → TRAIN → Xul commit. No operator may shortcut to Xul without traversing Ch'en verification.

weight_invariant.W_corpus: read-only; set by scraper pipeline; never overwritten by TRAIN
weight_invariant.W_learned: mutable; updated only after Ch'en_verification AND Xul_authorization

operators.description: Evaluates W·C·R, vector similarity, and metric evidence for each candidate. Populates evidence field for RANK. Does not select or admit.
Orders the admitted scored_candidates set. XCFE legality is a separate hard gate; high rank cannot promote an inadmissible candidate.

operators.note: Greymarch_record_only; Xul commit requires full authority path
operators.description: Total-order reduction via Jyggalag (T=0.00). Produces Greymarch record naming the surviving candidate. Not a topology commit. Sheogorath/Jyggalag must appear as a matched unit.

pair_constraint.law: Sheogorath generates the high-entropy candidate set that COLLAPSE reduces

operators.description: The Ch'en verification gate. verified_outcome is the only input that unlocks TRAIN. Does not commit; produces a gate token required by both TRAIN and Xul.
operators.gate_law: TRAIN dispatch is blocked (XCFE TRAIN UNVERIFIED) without verified_outcome from this operator

operators.description: Proposes W_learned delta from verified feedback. Requires verified_outcome from VERIFY/Ch'en and Xul_authorization. W_corpus is never overwritten.
Structured comparison of two candidates or evidence sets. Output feeds evidence_refs for VERIFY.
GramStore + vector evidence retrieval. Output feeds scored_candidates or evidence_refs into the SCORE→RANK pipeline.
VectorMuMicronaut geodesic projection. Returns a new bounded result substrate without mutating the target. Zero pattern inflation.
Question selector; drives clarification and intent-gap filling. Learned preferences keyed as q_pref:<gap_id>:<pattern> in GramStore.

pipeline_patterns.description: Full pre-verification pipeline without premature TRAIN
The only safe TRAIN path — forces verification before learning

invariants: SRAI redirects text through the pattern matcher; XCFE dispatch requires the [XCFE:OP] binding frame in the template
Every operator declares phase, executor, input_roles, output_role, and effects before dispatch
TRAIN requires verified_outcome from Ch'en; raw RANK output alone does not authorize learning
W_effective = W_corpus * W_learned; W_corpus is read-only; TRAIN updates only W_learned
COLLAPSE produces a Greymarch record; it is not a topology commit
No operator can shortcut to Xul without traversing the Ch'en verification gate
effects must be a subset of {read, measure, order, analyze, gate, project, emit, collapse, propose_delta}
Operators with propose_delta in effects must declare commit_requires fields
This registry describes operator contracts; aiml_engine.cpp + xcfe_executor.cpp supply the implementation
